limitations: One board per chip, one AP and room-temperature conditions; no calibrated RF measurement or long-duration reliability claim.
Entire allocated initialization member replaced, including parameter/control/table state; ROM callbacks and RX/TX calibration remain.
Original-instruction oracle compares ordered modeled boundary behavior; it does not prove cycle timing, RF or analog equivalence.
Packet gaps and latency tails remain open; this comparison records actual counts without claiming a fix.
AP Ethernet captures corroborate EAPOL exchanges but are not complete independent RF captures.

timing_observations.limits: Cumulative metrics cannot correlate a particular packet with an operation. Group losses in the comparison are preserved separately. No cycle-equivalence or packet-loss fix is claimed.

iram_placement.limits: Initialization callback targets retain their original runtime behavior. Entry/literal placement is not transitive flash-independence proof.

all_profile_allocation_gates.label: esp32c3-control-v1-phy_lifetime_smoke
all_profile_allocation_gates.method: Live archive input ranges wholly inside one ELF SHF_ALLOC output section; includes COMMON, excludes discarded/debug/nonallocated inputs and linker padding. Explicitly excludes object-verified mergeable string inputs; totals are non-string allocations, not complete archive attribution.
limits: Linked-image ownership does not establish ROM or calibration replacement.
Initial state hashes do not validate runtime calibration data.
Entry placement does not prove transitive flash independence.
Instruction and hardware behavior require separate validation.

validation_tool_corrections: Native interpreter permits only byte-checked reachable instructions and independently resolved constants. Verified terminal panic sites are recorded; no tested case reaches one.
Only argument 2 of phy_rfcal_data_check is masked because both original implementations ignore it. Other arguments and ordered effects remain checked.
Private libc initialization is modeled through memory effects and consumed-buffer snapshots, allowing LLVM to inline local copies. It cannot mutate PHY state or callback tables.
Mocked local results obey the implementation ranges used by LLVM interprocedural analysis.
The S3 second wakeup I2C write requires a different parameter/table-slot read order from the first; the draft was corrected before immutable builds and hardware trials.
